text: needs a stand. While the stand is not currently offered, it would definitely make filling these and storing them in the freezer easier.  I am currently working on getting something that will work while I try to procure the stand.  As the seller will tell you, often, whenever you freeze something, leave space at the top to account for expansion.  I will update if I find something that will work for a stand.  In the meantime, I would recommend buying something easier to fill and store - but then I've got PLENTY of freezer space.
